Common questions

Is a shredded note uploaded?

No. Text released with a private shred, burn, or dissolve action is not sent to the Unsend community database.

What happens when I post anonymously?

Your submission enters a private review queue. If approved, its text, category, and time become public in Explore. Other people can read and reply. Do not include names, addresses, contact details, or other identifying information.

Can I remove a public post or reply?

Yes. Delete your own visible post or reply in Explore, or delete your anonymous account and authored content in About. Our content deletion page explains how to request help with older or pending content.

Is Unsend a crisis or medical service?

No. Unsend does not provide medical care, diagnosis, counseling, emergency response, or crisis monitoring. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services. In the United States and its territories, call or text 988 for the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.
